title: Trade Unions Act, 1926 — Section 18 (Immunity from civil suit)

content.overview: Section 18 protects a registered trade union, and its office-bearers and members, from civil suits for acts done in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute.
content.glance: Section 18 protects a registered trade union, and its office-bearers and members, from civil suits for acts done in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute.
content.study: A suit will not lie against a registered trade union, or its office-bearers or members, for an act done in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute on the ground only that it induces another person to break a contract of employment, or that it interferes with the trade, business or employment of some other person.

sections.body: Section 18 protects a registered trade union, and its office-bearers and members, from civil suits for acts done in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute.
